description: a mighty guardian of the world, a woman with a slim feminine figure, light skin, dark brown hair in a long high ponytail hanging straight down her back from under the helmet at rest, not flying, an open ivory and gold helmet with a tall golden crest, armour of ivory and white gold shaped for a woman with thin golden lines like roots, huge rounded golden pauldrons, a deep emerald green tabard with golden trim, a long deep emerald green cape hanging behind from the shoulders, ivory and gold greaves and boots, a strong beautiful young woman's face in clean profile with one eye, no shield, no hammer, no dome of light and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the helmet's crest to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same character seen from the side: face, ponytail, helmet, armour, tabard, cape, colours and drawing style; not the sitting pose and not the hands on the reins: she stands and walks
the character's look in detail: face, ponytail, helmet, armour, tabard, cape and colours; the hands empty, without the shield, the hammer and the dome of light
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, upright mid-step, not turned towards the viewer; copy it exactly
